name: City Camp
street_address: Joslin Park (behind William D'abate School), Florence Street
description_short: A free day camp run by ECC for children ages 6-12 who live in the Olneyville and Manton neighborhoods of Providence. Each day starts and ends at Joslin Park, runs 10am-3pm, and includes field trips to places like ECC, the zoo and bowling.
